summary.text: This resolution provides for the House to attend the inaugural ceremonies of the President and Vice President of the United States on January 20, 2025, and, thereafter, for the House to stand adjourned until 12:00 p.m. (noon) on January 21, 2025.

title: Providing for the attendance of the House at the Inaugural Ceremonies of the President and Vice President of the United States.
